verdict.rationale: Graphite's docs say its codebase-aware AI review agent automatically reviews every PR, identifies potential issues, suggests fixes, and catches bugs before they ship. Custom rules and comment exclusions offer a way to steer it away from low-value comments. However, the claims are generic marketing statements, with no evidence about the kinds of bugs it finds or how accurate it is. missing for 10: documented detection of logic errors, race conditions or edge-case bugs specifically, evidence on precision versus style-nit noise, independent or hands-on corroboration of review accuracy.
